/* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.admin.mapper.AnnouncementMapper.selectAnnouncement */ /* 공고 상세 조회 */
SELECT cap.ann_no AS annNo , cap.board_no AS boardNo , cbi.board_nm AS boardNm , cbi.board_ty_cd AS boardTyCd , cbi.apt_cmplex_no AS aptCmplexNo , ac.apt_cmplex_nm AS aptCmplexNm , cap.ttl AS ttl , cap.cn AS cn , cap.wrtr_id AS wrtrId , cap.top_fix_yn AS topFixYn , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblancBgngDt , TO_CHAR(cap.pblanc_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS pblancEndDt , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrtBgngDt , TO_CHAR(cap.rcrt_end_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS rcrtEndDt , TO_CHAR(cap.reg_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS regDttm , TO_CHAR(cap.mdf_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS mdfDttm , NVL(cap.inq_cnt, 0) AS inqCnt , NVL(cap.del_yn, 'N') AS delYn , NVL(cap.opn_yn, 'Y') AS opnYn , cap.atch_file_id AS atchFileId , NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(au.unit_cnt, 0)) FROM apt_unit au WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = cbi.apt_cmplex_no ), NVL(ac.unit_cnt, 0)) AS unitCnt , ( SELECT LISTAGG(af.file_og_name, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY af.file_sort_order, af.file_og_name) FROM attach_file af WHERE TO_CHAR(af.file_group_no) = cap.atch_file_id ) AS sbmsnDocNm , CASE WHEN cap.rcrt_bgng_dt IS NULL OR cap.rcrt_end_dt IS NULL THEN '-' WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) < TRUNC(cap.rcrt_bgng_dt) THEN '예정' WHEN TRUNC(SYSDATE) > TRUNC(cap.rcrt_end_dt) THEN '마감' ELSE '진행중' END AS statusNm FROM center_ann_board_post cap INNER JOIN center_board_instance cbi ON cap.board_no = cbi.board_no LEFT JOIN apt_complex ac ON cbi.apt_cmplex_no = ac.apt_cmplex_no WHERE cap.ann_no = #{annNo} AND NVL(cap.del_yn, 'N') = 'N'
mapper.update:
/* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.admin.mapper.AnnouncementMapper.updateAnnouncement */ /* 공고 수정 */
UPDATE center_ann_board_post SET ttl = #{ttl} /** 제목 */ , cn = #{cn} /** 내용 */ , pblanc_bgng_dt = TO_DATE(#{pblancBgngDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , pblanc_end_dt = TO_DATE(#{pblancEndDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , rcrt_bgng_dt = TO_DATE(#{rcrtBgngDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , rcrt_end_dt = TO_DATE(#{rcrtEndDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , mdf_dttm = SYSDATE /** 수정일시 */ WHERE ann_no = #{annNo} AND NVL(del_yn, 'N') = 'N'
mapper.select:
/* kr.or.ddit.domain.central.admin.mapper.AnnouncementMapper.selectAptComplexList */ /* 단지 목록 조회 */
SELECT ac.apt_cmplex_no AS aptCmplexNo , ac.apt_cmplex_nm AS aptCmplexNm , NVL(( SELECT SUM(NVL(au.unit_cnt, 0)) FROM apt_unit au WHERE au.apt_cmplex_no = ac.apt_cmplex_no ), NVL(ac.unit_cnt, 0)) AS unitCnt FROM apt_complex ac WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM center_board_instance cbi WHERE cbi.apt_cmplex_no = ac.apt_cmplex_no AND NVL(cbi.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' ) ORDER BY ac.apt_cmplex_nm
